title: Adult Skeletal Age-at-Death Estimation through Deep Random Neural Networks: A New Method and Its Computational Analysis.
summary: A deep random neural-network regression estimated age-at-death from 64 skeletal traits in 500 identified skeletons, with cross-validated error around six years. This is a specific forensic estimation result; independent observer validation remains needed. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.
